title: The stem-stiffness switch, on all four land plants
question: You asked to see these. It is NOT 'looks identical' -- and it is not cosmetic either: it changes how big plants get. Flip it world-wide, or give the reed a private route to a straight stem and leave these four alone?
context_md:
Same bed, same seed, same binary, five founders each, 30,000 frames (grass 20,000). Top to bottom: **tree, conifer, shrub, grass**. The only difference is the selector.

**A is what ships today.** B is each species using the stiffness it already authors in its own file -- `tree` [1.0, 0.9, 0.8, 0.7], `conifer` [1.0, 0.85, 0.7, 0.6], `shrub` [0.7, 0.55], `grass` [0.9, 0.8]. Those values have sat in the files unused.

**Why I am asking.** The reed can only stand straight with this on, and you said the straight and wandering versions looked like two separate water plants. But a species cannot opt in on its own -- the selector forces 0 and never reads the file -- so having both water plants means turning it on for everything.

**`7d731d54` records you judging this "looks identical" and the switch staying off.** On this bed it is not identical for tree, conifer or shrub.

**And the part I did not expect, which is why I am not just recommending it.** It does not only straighten stems, it changes how much plant there is:

| | cells, A -> B | biggest single plant |
|---|---|---|
| tree | 22,201 -> 20,729 | 6,029 -> 5,016 |
| conifer | 24,886 -> 24,705 | 6,075 -> 6,492 |
| shrub | 6,260 -> **3,458** | 1,821 -> 1,636 |
| grass | 3,735 -> **6,754** | 57 -> **701** |

Shrub loses nearly half its mass; a single grass plant gets **twelve times bigger** and its roots reach 11 rows down instead of 87. That follows from the mechanism -- a straighter stem covers more ground per unit of growth budget, the same reason the reed got 68 cells above the waterline instead of 13 -- but it means every number tuned against these species was tuned against the wandering version.

**So the honest options are:** flip it and accept that four species need re-checking, or leave these four alone and let the reed reach its authored value some other way. The second is a small engine change and touches nothing that already works.

items.label: A -- what ships today (switch off)
items.caption: Every species' authored stiffness is ignored; the selector forces 0.

items.label: B -- each species using the value in its own file
items.caption: Nothing else differs. Trees open out, conifers gain a trunk, shrub thins, grass grows far larger.
